records.label: Term Taxonomy ID Relationship Identity
records.description: WordPress term_relationships connects objects to term_taxonomy_id rather than directly to term_id; adapter mappings must preserve that distinction.

records.label: Taxonomy Sort Dependency For Term Order
records.description: Native relationship order is rewritten only when the registered taxonomy enables sort; effective adapter ordering must expose that dependency.

records.label: Validate Taxonomy Object-Type Association Before Connect
records.description: wp_set_object_terms() can pair an object with a taxonomy term without checking that the object type is registered to that taxonomy; WPE must validate the endpoint association before mutation.

records.label: Hierarchical Post Type Requirement
records.description: The post-parent adapter is a hierarchy relation and must validate the registered post type hierarchy contract instead of treating post_parent as a generic arbitrary edge.

records.label: Native Post Parent Hierarchy Loop Guard
records.description: WordPress filters post_parent during insert/update to prevent hierarchy loops; the native adapter must preserve this current-core invariant separately from future generic graph cycle policies.

records.label: Reparent Children When Hierarchical Parent Is Deleted
records.description: When a hierarchical post is deleted, WordPress reassigns its same-type children to the deleted post's parent; native adapter lifecycle must surface this effective behavior.

records.label: Remove Object-Term Edges When Post Is Deleted
records.description: WordPress post deletion unlinks the post from all registered taxonomy relationships before deleting the post; native adapter lifecycle must preserve this cleanup semantic.

coverage.notes: Native-audit gaps found after the Relations V1 seed: WordPress relationship identity/dependencies, adapter validation, hierarchy-loop and deletion cleanup semantics.
